floor_history.headline: Baseline 15; residue localized to cross-jump-store-tail-merge on switch(ret) arms + missing dead-branch-sched lui $v1
Structural mix: shared do_call + shared complete_store dropped 3 stores to sw-source-reg divergence; floor 15->10, 3-insn shortfall remains on per-arm mask hoist.
Structural split-init `var_v1 |=` at complete_store dropped floor 10 -> 6; forces GCC to reuse var_v1's register for final OR while preserving per-arm mask compute.

frontier.hypothesis: Force reorg.c to prefer dead-branch fill (else-arm's lui $v1) over fall-through fill (then-arm's lui $v0) in each case's if -- adds the 2 missing insns AND fixes the register substitution cascade in one lever, closing floor 6 -> ~0/1.
frontier.mechanism: reorg.c fill_slots_from_thread evaluates both fill candidates; picks based on cost + reg-liveness. Making then-arm's first insn ineligible for fill (e.g., non-hoistable, sched-anchored) forces else-arm insn to win. Candidates: (a) precompute the then-arm mask address as a stack-anchored expression; (b) make then-arm's first insn depend on something reorg won't hoist across a call boundary.
frontier.next_probe: s4: try (a) writing then-arm as `D_800A34F8 = a0 - (a0 & 0xE000);` (algebraic equivalent -- a0 & 0xFFFF1FFF is a0 with top 3 of low 16 cleared, and 0xE000 has already been ANDed and compared, so subtraction is equivalent when the compare succeeded). Different RTL shape -> different fill priority. If regresses, try (b) explicit `t = a0 << 16 >> 16 | (a0 & 0xFFFF0000)`-style spelling that emits `sll+srl+or` instead of `lui+ori+and` -- forces then-arm to not need the lui at all, freeing the delay slot for dead-branch fill of else.

frontier.hypothesis: Directed-PERM permuter from h2a base can find the exact spelling that produces target's dual-lui + $v1-substitution pattern within the C-source degrees of freedom, per the cross-jump-store-tail-deep-dive precedent (V2b + inline_ret_mode dropped saEft00Add 15->8 via a shape not enumerated by manual variants).
frontier.mechanism: Same trilemma family as saEft00Add (documented in cross-jump-store-tail-deep-dive): unmerged tails / JF-LOOP-safe eager fills / v0 reuse are coupled. h2a already achieves 2 of 3; the third (dual-lui with correct reg subst) may be reachable via a spelling reorderingthat permuter can find but hand-enumeration missed.
frontier.next_probe: s4: seed permuter/func_8006B92C/ with h2a base + PERM_GENERAL and PERM_RANDOMIZE_TYPE macros around the switch arms; run ~20-30k iters with fresh seeds per permuter-fresh-seed-discipline; target sandbox 0-2. If plateau at 4-6 with no closer, escalate as documented coupled fixpoint (do NOT owner-gate -- floor still dropping counts as grindable).

frontier.hypothesis: Statement-reassociation of the else-arm mask `a0 & 0xFFFF1FFF` (e.g. `~(a0 & 0xE000) & a0` or the algebraic `a0 - (a0 & 0xE000)`) may emit different RTL that steers reorg to different fill decisions.
frontier.mechanism: Same underlying value but different combine.c intermediate forms -- combine may or may not fold to the same lui+ori+and depending on the input tree shape. If it emits e.g. andi+not+and or sub-based, the lui is gone and delay-slot fill changes fundamentally.
frontier.next_probe: s4: try (i) `var_v1 = a0 - (a0 & 0xE000);` in else arms (algebraic equiv when the else-branch was taken from `(a0 & 0xE000) == 0x4000` false OR `(a0 & 0xE000) == 0` false -- wait, algebraic equivalence needs proof); (ii) `var_v1 = a0 ^ (a0 & 0xE000);` (same via xor); (iii) narrow-integer-type on var_v1 (u16 halfword form). Measure each.
